name: system-reality-alignment
description: Design, review, plan, repair, implement, operate, and evaluate real-world systems with reproducible evidence, explicit semantics, verifiable decisions, and closed feedback loops.

interface.shortDescription: Align and evaluate system models against reality
interface.longDescription: A rigorous workflow for designing, reviewing, planning, repairing, implementing, operating, and evaluating software and socio-technical systems using reproducible evidence, mechanism isolation, explicit observations, semantics, invariants, lineage, reconciliation, and outcome feedback.
defaultPrompt: Use System Reality Alignment to review this system and produce reproducible evidence-backed findings.
Use System Reality Alignment to design a traceable decision and feedback loop for this workflow.
Use System Reality Alignment to evaluate whether this intervention is useful, neutral, harmful, or still unknown.
